name: io.github.RedHold/diagrams-so-mcp
title: Diagrams.so
description: Generate and edit AWS, Azure, GCP and Kubernetes architecture diagrams as editable draw.io files.

environmentVariables.name: DIAGRAMS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Diagrams.so API key (dgz_live_... or dgz_test_...). Optional since 1.4.0: run `npx @diagrams-so/mcp login` once instead. Or create a key at https://diagrams.so under Settings then AI Provider.

environmentVariables.name: DIAGRAMS_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to production; override only for a local or self-hosted API.

environmentVariables.name: DIAGRAMS_API_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for slow generate/edit/fix calls.
